# DevPul

> Open source debug bridge between a running Dart or Flutter app and a browser UI. The app posts HTTP calls, errors, session info and custom events with `dart:developer` `postEvent`; the browser reads them live from the Dart Development Service (DDS) websocket on 127.0.0.1. No proxy, no certificates, no server. Debug builds only. MIT licensed.

The hosted UI is at https://devpul.saradgajurel.com.np/. It also runs locally with `npx devpul` or as a downloaded single HTML file.

## Packages

- [devpul](https://github.com/ictsolved/devpul/tree/main/packages/devpul): pure Dart core. `Devpul.emit`, `Devpul.session`, `Devpul.error`, `Devpul.tags`, `DevpulConfig`, `DevpulHttp` for HTTP adapters.
- [devpul_dio](https://github.com/ictsolved/devpul/tree/main/packages/devpul_dio): `DevpulDioInterceptor` for Dio.
- [devpul_flutter](https://github.com/ictsolved/devpul/tree/main/packages/devpul_flutter): `DevpulFlutter.install()` reports FlutterError and uncaught platform errors.
- [launcher](https://github.com/ictsolved/devpul/tree/main/launcher): `npx devpul` serves the UI on 127.0.0.1.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/ictsolved/devpul#readme): setup, configuration, event schema, UI plugins, browser support, security notes.
- [Example app](https://github.com/ictsolved/devpul/tree/main/examples/devpul_example)

## Key facts

- Connect by pasting the VM service URL printed by `flutter run`, `flutter attach` or `dart run --enable-vm-service`. Optional fixed URL: run with `--dds-port=8181 --disable-service-auth-codes` and use `ws://127.0.0.1:8181/ws`.
- Events are named `devpul.<kind>` on the VM service Extension stream. Kinds: `http.request`, `http.response`, `http.error`, `app.session`, `error`, and any custom kind.
- Chrome and Firefox ask for permission before a hosted page connects to 127.0.0.1 (local network access). Safari blocks it; use the local version.
- Works on Flutter Android, iOS, desktop and web, and plain Dart with `dart run --enable-vm-service`.
